evidence.quote: תני תנא קמיה דר' יוחנן כל העוסק בתורה ובגמילות חסדים
וקובר את בניו מוחלין לו על כל עונותיו
תנא ליה ההוא סבא משום ר' שמעון בן יוחאי אתיא עון עון כתיב הכא בחסד ואמת יכופר עון וכתיב התם (ירמיהו לב, יח) ומשלם עון אבות אל חיק בניהם.

findings.finding: c1.conditions is one prose description rather than separately inspectable antecedents; p1.conditions is empty. c5.conditions contains a statement about provenance and no inferred motive, not an antecedent condition. The conjunction is correctly preserved in c1.proposition, so this is not a false source claim.
findings.action: In a new superseding revision encode Torah study, acts of kindness, and burying sons/children as c1 antecedents and carry these to p1 or explicitly document inheritance from claim. Set c5.conditions to [] and retain its explanatory metadata in scope or uncertainty. Preserve conjunction; do not assert independent sufficiency.
findings.release_implication: Does not invalidate quoted teaching; normalize before views that interpret empty position conditions as unconditional.

findings.finding: Producer splits listed categories into individual claims where initial reader grouped them. All two Nisan and five Tishrei categories are present.
findings.action: None; do not count record-count disagreement as omission.

evidence.quote: באחד באלול ראש השנה למעשר בהמה ר' אלעזר ור"ש אומרים באחד בתשרי
באחד בשבט ראש השנה לאילן כדברי בית שמאי בית הלל אומרים בחמשה עשר בו:

findings.finding: Producer has no questions or edges in Mishnah; independent reader created two editorial topic questions and answer alignments. No explicit interrogative or directed proof argument occurs in core. The paired positions and holders are retained in producer.
findings.action: Optional topic-inventory enrichment may add reconstructed questions with editorial provenance and link corresponding positions. Do not invent explicit questions or label one view an objection to the other merely from sequence.
findings.release_implication: Not an explicit-source omission; topic-choice view remains unqualified without its own policy.

findings.finding: All four producer edge directions agree with source: explanatory concession supports teaching, kindness/truth interpretations support the concession, and derivation answers the question. Independent reader also gives derivation-to-original-claim support. Producer preserves the answer-to-question link and the question states the target clause.
findings.action: Optionally add c5 to c1 support with scope limited to burial clause; current absence is no reversal or missing answer.

findings.finding: Producer c3/c4 evidence contains the interpretive identifications but not their adjacent individual proof verses; full composite utterance and c2 evidence preserve the verses. Independent reader anchors each identification together with its verse.
findings.action: For granular proof retrieval, expand c3/c4 evidence or separately model supporting citations. No text is absent from the composite utterance.

findings.finding: Four New Year dates is understandable shorthand, but can misleadingly imply that the union of dates across alternatives has cardinality four. The source says four new years.
findings.action: Prefer The Mishnah enumerates four new years, with locally stated date alternatives. No category or date correction is required.
